title: Special Height and Setback Regulations
previewText: The underlying height and setback regulations shall apply, except that no building or other structure shall exceed a height limit of 35 feet, and the height shall be measured from the base plane. Such height and setback regulations may be modified only by authorization or special permit of the City Planning Commission, as applicable, pursuant to Sections 112-12 or 112-13.
